pins.name: GPIO0
pins.label: GPIO0
pins.notes: Must be HIGH or floating for normal boot; LOW at boot enters flash/programming mode. No interrupt support. Often wired to a FLASH/BOOT button on ESP-01 programmer adapters

pins.name: GPIO1
pins.label: GPIO1
pins.notes: Hardware UART0 TX0 — used by the Serial pfod connection, not available as a general GPIO

pins.name: GPIO2
pins.label: GPIO2
pins.notes: Must be HIGH at boot. Commonly wired to the on-board LED

pins.name: GPIO3
pins.label: GPIO3
pins.notes: Hardware UART0 RX0 — used by the Serial pfod connection, not available as a general GPIO
